title: 18″ Nice Glass Top Glass Beaker Bong
description:
Nice Glass 18″ Fumed Top Glass Beaker
Borosilicate glass
Joint size: 14mm
Ice notches
Iridescent fumed glass swirls
Base diameter: 140mm
A tall beauty featuring a fumed base and a stylish mouthpiece that is flared at the opening. Opalesque colors add a special sophistication to the swirls. It comes with a slitted downstem and a single-hole herb bowl.
